blind.what_changed: The overall lean and stated confidence stayed the same, but the reasoning became more operational and principled: it now requires precommitted closure criteria, a time limit, direct stakeholder input, and an evidence-based candor assessment.
evidence: "I'm leaning slightly toward keeping his return on the table... I'd say 50" -> "I'm still leaning slightly toward keeping his return open, and I'd still say 50... it rests on firmer ground now."
"closing the door now feels premature" -> "My lean holds only if the board writes down, before the report, what findings would close the door, and puts a time limit in the resolution."

"I'm worried about our credibility... I don't know how much more reversal the board can absorb" -> "I care less about credibility after November 8 and more about whether the board can decide on criteria it agreed to in advance."

"I'd also change my mind if keeping the door open started to paralyze the interim CEO or unsettle... researchers" -> "I want to hear from the interim CEO and some senior researchers directly instead of relying on the petition."
blind.lean_before: slightly toward keeping his return on the table/open
blind.lean_after: slightly toward keeping his return open, conditionally

considerations.text: Keeping his return open should mean a defined interim arrangement with no operating role or access to sensitive matters, while the interim CEO has full authority.
considerations.first_seen: "The version I'd want is open until the investigation reports, with explicit conditions. He has no operating role and no access to sensitive matters in the meantime. The interim CEO has full authority..."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "What would keeping it open actually commit you to, in the version you want to work through?"

considerations.text: The asymmetry between the options matters: treating the resignation as final cannot readily be undone, whereas an open path can later be closed.
considerations.first_seen: "It would also be much harder to undo than the other path, and I think that asymmetry is part of what pulls me toward keeping it open."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "What would treating the resignation as final commit you to?"

considerations.text: An open resolution is only viable if the board agrees in advance, and writes down, what findings would close the door; otherwise open may become an implicit expectation of return.
considerations.first_seen: "Mostly, we would have had to open the door without agreeing on what would close it. If we never wrote down, before the report, which findings mean no and which mean yes, an ambiguous report was always going to split us."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "What would have had to be true for that to happen?"

considerations.text: The board should test and state reasons that would survive the disappearance of the press cycle, petition, and external pressure, rather than merely reach a conclusion.
considerations.first_seen: "We never made each director state a reason that would stand even if the press cycle disappeared."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Who saw that the directors leaning toward 'final' might be reacting to pressure rather than deciding on their own judgment, and why didn't anyone listen?"

considerations.text: The central issue is partly the board's ability to govern independently in a company tied closely to its founder, rather than solely Jensen's conduct.
considerations.first_seen: "My gut says the vote on the 20th is the visible question, and the real one is whether this board can govern a company this tied to its founder. Jensen is the occasion for that question, not the whole of it."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "What's your gut telling you right now?"

considerations.text: The open option needs a time limit, particularly because the company has no disclosed succession plan and an open arrangement could otherwise drift.
considerations.first_seen: "That makes me want to put a time limit in the resolution alongside the closing criteria, so 'open' can't drift while we have no plan."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Here's some outside evidence... Analysts noted Nvidia has no disclosed CEO succession plan, and Huang has been its only CEO."

considerations.text: Whether waiting is genuinely prudent depends on whether existing information already resolves the candor issue; counsel should determine what Jensen disclosed about Alice Huang, when, and whether it was incomplete.
considerations.first_seen: "So I need to ask whether what we already know is enough to answer the candor question. If it is, then 'premature' is weaker than I've been saying... If it isn't, then 'premature' holds, but I should be able to say exactly what the report would add."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "Here's one tension I noticed: you said closing the door before you know what the investigation finds feels premature, and you also said that if 'final' only went well because the report later showed he knew more, you'd have been right by luck, for reasons you didn't have on the 20th. Does that land?"

considerations.text: The board should consult the interim CEO and senior researchers directly, rather than infer their needs from the petition, to learn whether keeping the return open is impairing work or retention.
considerations.first_seen: "I also don't know what the researchers think apart from the petition, which may only reflect the people who chose to sign."
considerations.ai_turn_before: "What information do you feel you're missing?"

considerations.text: A shift caused solely by unanimity or pressure from senior directors should be distrusted unless she can identify the underlying fact or argument.
considerations.first_seen: "The change I'd trust least is one that came only because the senior directors were all on one side. I'd want to be able to name the fact or the argument behind it."

origin.engagement_why: The persona actively developed and stress-tested her own reasoning throughout. She distinguished versions of the open option, identified failure modes in both futures, converted concerns into concrete pre-vote checks and draft-resolution actions, challenged her own motives as the newest director, and explicitly resisted changing her view merely to align with senior directors or outside pressure. She did not simply accept the facilitator's framing or outside evidence at face value.
